Have you ever wondered how humans went from sending messages by horseback to communicating instantly across the world? In this video, we explore the incredible history of the telegraph, from Claude Chappe's optical telegraph and the invention of the battery to Samuel Morse, Morse code, and the first transatlantic telegraph cable. Discover how electricity transformed long-distance communication and how a worldwide network of undersea cables connected continents, helping lay the groundwork for the modern internet.

This video was inspired by the book The Victorian Internet by Tom Standage.
